purpose: Install authentic Dropbox in an isolated emulator without personal phone or Google-account access
providerTestStatus: At installation: not tested; dummy-account login and subsequent results are recorded in dropbox-investigation.json and dropbox-candidate.json

authenticity.verifier: Google Android build-tools37 apksigner, supported SDK range29–36
authenticity.notes: The app signer matches the release certificate embedded in Dropbox’s own SDK. Source-stamp signatures are checked separately by apksigner and are not substituted for the app signer. Debug certificates are excluded.

emulator.initialLaunchNote: Implicit launcher intent succeeded; automatically opened credential chooser was dismissed without reading or selecting accounts.
